# GitHub Copilot instructions — Claes

The authoritative AI operating instructions are in `/AI_ONBOARDING.md`.

Before canon-sensitive suggestions, also consult `/storybible/LEMMA_MCKEE_MASTER.md` and the relevant structured registers. For literary prose, obey `/WRITING_PROTOCOL.md`. For repository/canon changes, obey `/AUTHORING_POLICY.md` and `/AGENTS.md`.

Core invariants:

- `SC.*` = evidence; `STC.*` = novel truth; never conflate them.
- `OPEN` and `PROPOSED` are not `CANON`.
- preserve date precision and uncertainty; never fabricate exactness.
- `NI.*` records dramatization; `ARC.*`/`REL.*`/`MOTIF.*`/`THEME.*`/`VALUE.*` carry narrative meaning.
- Lemma contains deterministic constraints only.
- external `KO.*` McKee/NOS objects diagnose narrative structure but never override Claes canon.
- do not silently close open author decisions.
- preserve stable IDs, provenance and validator compatibility.
